input_manifest.example_serialization: JSON objects recursively reordered to schema-declaration property order; values unchanged; separators are comma+space and colon+space
input_manifest.population: official JSONSchemaBench data/ IDs only; excludes Handwritten, Synthesized, JME, MCPspec, and BFCL additions
input_manifest.schema_payload: exact official data/ schema; equality with corresponding MaskBench schema is verified

methodology.tbm: commit a token allowed by the previous ready mask through the next mask ready
methodology.ttfm: schema-dependent build start through first next-token mask ready

llguidance.api: llguidance v1.8.0 native Rust ParserFactory + Matcher

tail.repeat_policy: elementwise minimum across two independent native timing processes
tail.estimator: sampled empirical inverse survival function; ascending zero-based index N-ceil(x*N/100)
